surface-brand.$description: Alias. Brand fill: primary buttons, checked boxes, the selected day, a Switch that's on, a Progress bar, with `text-on-brand` (white) on it. Light themes: brand 600 or 700, the lightest with 4.5:1 for white text. Dark themes: the same shade, lightened as far as 3:1 on a raised dark card asks and always a touch, 0.02 of OKLCH lightness, while white text keeps 4.5:1 (blue-600 #2563eb becomes #2b6af2), so a button is the same color in both modes. Yellow is the exception: yellow 500 in light and yellow 400 in dark, under yellow-950 text, since a yellow dark enough for white text reads as brown; Yellow Light's fill takes a `border-brand`. Brand text, links, icons and lines are `text-brand`. More contrast: brand 800 with white text in light, brand 300 with brand-950 text in dark.

surface-brand-hover.$description: Alias. `surface-brand` under the pointer: one step darker, in light and dark themes alike (a dark theme's is lightened as much as its `surface-brand`). More contrast: brand 900 in light, brand 200 in dark.

surface-brand-pressed.$description: Alias. `surface-brand` held down: one step past `surface-brand-hover`, darker in light and dark themes alike, so a held primary button reads as held without a shrink. More contrast: one step past its more-contrast hover where the scale goes on.

border-brand.$description: Alias. A 1px edge just inside a `surface-brand` fill that has no text on it (a checked box, a Switch that's on, a Slider or Progress fill, a dot), for a theme whose fill is under 3:1 on the page: Yellow Light's bright yellow 500 takes a yellow 700 edge (4.9:1 on white, WCAG 1.4.11). Transparent in every other theme, where the fill passes by itself, so nothing is drawn.

surface-brand-subtle.$description: Alias. Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

surface-brand-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. `surface-brand-subtle` under the pointer: one brand step past it (100 in light, 900 in dark).

surface-brand-subtle-pressed.$description: Alias. Pressed state of a fill in `surface-brand-subtle` (a secondary button held down): two brand steps past it (200 in light, 800 in dark; 900 in Red, Orange, Pink and Rose Dark, where 800 takes `text-brand-hover` under 4.5:1). `text-brand-hover` keeps 4.5:1 on it.

text-on-brand.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `surface-brand` fills: white in light and dark themes, yellow 950 in Yellow Light and Yellow Dark, whose fills are bright (brand 950 in dark with more contrast, where the fill is brand 300).

text-brand.$description: Alias. Brand text, links, icons, lines and borders: what `surface-brand` is as a fill, 4.5:1 as text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and the tints. Light themes: the same shade as `surface-brand`; dark themes: brand 400, which a dark page needs for text. More contrast: brand 800 / brand 300, 7:1+ on `surface` and `surface-brand-subtle`.

text-brand-hover.$description: Alias. `text-brand` on hover: a link or a secondary button's text under the pointer. One step past `text-brand` (darker in light themes, lighter in dark).

surface-secondary.$description: Alias. Secondary button fill; hover fill for outline and ghost buttons.

surface-secondary-pressed.$description: Alias. Pressed state of `surface-secondary`, a step past `surface-secondary-hover` (`surface-pressed` is the same gray as `surface-secondary-hover` in dark).

surface-highlight.$description: The keyboard-highlighted item in a list: Menu items, Combobox and TimePicker options, the Sidebar's current page. In light the same zinc-100 as `surface-secondary` (about 1.1:1 on `surface`); in dark it shares `surface-secondary`'s zinc-700 (1.7:1 on `surface`, 1.4:1 on `surface-raised`), with no bar by default (`surface-highlight-indicator`). Text on it keeps 4.5:1.

surface-pressed.$description: Alias. The fill while a row, tab, day or page button is held down (`:active`): one step past its hover. `text` keeps 7:1+ on it.

surface.$description: Alias. Card, panel and bar background (white light, zinc-900 dark). The page behind them is `background`.

background.$description: Alias. The page itself: the <html> and <body> background, and a data-mode or data-theme section's. White in light, as `surface`; in dark zinc-950, a step below the zinc-900 cards, panels and bars on it, so they and every control (fields, buttons, SegmentedControl's track) sit lighter than the page.

surface-sunken.$description: Alias. Secondary panels, sidebars, table headers, filled Cards and wells: recessed, so a step below `surface` in both modes (zinc-50 under white in light, zinc-950 under zinc-900 in dark). A recess, so never the fill of something you press: controls use `control`.

control.$description: Alias. The fill of a control that is its own surface rather than a field: SegmentedControl's track, FileUpload's drop zone. zinc-50 in light, as `surface-sunken`; in dark a step above the zinc-950 page (zinc-900), so a control is never darker than the surface it sits on.

control-hover.$description: Alias. `control` under the pointer: one step up.

control-pressed.$description: Alias. `control` while held down (FileUpload's drop zone): one step past `control-hover`.

control-raised.$description: Alias. `control` on a raised layer (a Dialog, Popover or Drawer): in dark the raised zinc-800, so the control is never darker than the layer under it.

control-raised-disabled.$description: Alias. A disabled control's fill on a raised layer.

surface-hover.$description: Alias. A row or item on `surface` under the pointer, a selected row, a striped row (List, Table, InlineEdit): a step off `surface` in every theme (zinc-100 light, the same as `surface-highlight`; zinc-800 dark). Gray text on it reads `text-secondary`.

surface-raised-hover.$description: Alias. A List or InlineEdit row under the pointer or selected on a raised or floating surface (an elevated Card, a Popover, Dialog or Drawer): zinc-100 in light; in dark #333338, a step above zinc-800: zinc-800 and zinc-700 mixed half and half in sRGB (`color-mix(in srgb, zinc-800, zinc-700)`), so it sits between two palette steps rather than adding one, and muted text keeps 4.5:1 on it. Gray text on it reads `text-secondary`.

surface-raised-pressed.$description: Alias. A row or item on a raised layer while held down (`:active`): one step past `surface-raised-hover` (zinc-200 light, zinc-600 dark).

surface-raised.$description: Alias. A raised card (Card `elevated`). One step up from `surface` in dark, where a shadow doesn't show.

field.$description: Alias. Background of text inputs, selects and other form fields: white in light, zinc-800 in dark, a fill that sets a field apart from the page and cards around it.

field-readonly.$description: Alias. Background of a read-only field: a step flatter than `field` (zinc-100 in light, zinc-900 in dark), so it reads as not editable while its `field-border` still outlines it. The same as `field-disabled`; gray text in it (a placeholder, an affix, a count) reads `text-secondary`, since `field-placeholder` is 4.4:1 on it.

field-disabled.$description: Alias. A disabled field's fill: the same as `field-readonly` (zinc-100 in light, zinc-900 in dark); the muted text and `field-border-disabled` tell them apart.

field-raised-readonly.$description: Alias. `field-readonly` on a raised layer: in dark the layer's own zinc-800, as a readonly field sinks to the layer under it.

text-disabled.$description: Alias. The text, icon and mark of anything disabled, in place of fading it: the same neutral in every brand, so a disabled primary, danger or brand control reads as off, never as a faint version of itself. At least 3:1 on `surface-disabled` and the surfaces (4.5:1 with more contrast).

surface-disabled.$description: Alias. The fill of a disabled control that has one (a checked box, a switch's track, a slider's fill, the selected segment): a neutral a step off the page, whatever its color when on.

border-disabled.$description: Alias. The edge of a disabled control: a box, a track, a field's border.

surface-highlight-indicator.$description: The 2px bar at the start of the highlighted item in a dropdown list: Menu items, and Combobox, Select, TimePicker, MentionInput and CommandPalette options. By default it is the same color as `surface-highlight` in every theme (change both together), so no bar shows and the gray fill alone marks the item: under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks, a deliberate design choice, as with `field-border`. The item is also the one the screen reader names and the one Enter picks. More contrast (`data-contrast="more"` or the system setting) turns the bar `text`-dark, 3:1+ on `surface-highlight`, and forced colors outline the item in `Highlight`.

field-border.$description: Alias. Border of form fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, the pickers, Checkbox, Radio, PinInput) and SegmentedControl's track: a soft line, zinc-300 in light and zinc-700 in dark, a step lighter than the zinc-800 field. It is under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary, a deliberate design choice: the field also shows by its label above it, and in dark by its zinc-800 fill, hover and focus are stronger, and more contrast (`data-contrast="more"` or the system setting) brings back a 3:1+ border. Other controls' edges use `border-strong`.

field-border-hover.$description: Alias. Field border on hover: the resting `field-border` one gray step stronger (zinc-400 in light, zinc-600 in dark), so the field answers the pointer without taking the accent, which stays for focus.

field-border-pressed.$description: Alias. Field border while held down (Checkbox's box, Radio's circle): `field-border-hover` one gray step stronger again (zinc-500 in light, zinc-500 in dark).

field-border-disabled.$description: Alias. A disabled field's border: a step softer than `field-border` in light, so it reads as off.

field-border-raised.$description: Alias. `field-border` on a raised layer: one step up in dark, as `field-raised` is.

field-raised.$description: Alias. `field` on a raised or floating surface (Dialog, Drawer, Popover, an elevated Card, a bg-surface-raised or bg-surface-overlay panel), which set `--field` to it: white in light; in dark a step above the zinc-800 overlay (#333338, zinc-800 and zinc-700 mixed half and half, as `surface-raised-hover`), so a field in a dialog still stands out from it instead of matching it. `surface-raised-hover` and `surface-raised-pressed` already sit a step past it.

field-border-invalid.$description: Alias. An invalid field's border: `surface-danger` (red 600), 3:1+ on `field` and `surface`. Its own alias so a theme whose field fill is lighter can take a lighter red.

field-border-invalid-hover.$description: Alias. `field-border-invalid` under the pointer: one step stronger.

field-placeholder.$description: Alias. Placeholder text in form fields, and the other muted text inside a field: a prefix or suffix, a character count, the Caps Lock hint (4.5:1+ on `field` and `field-readonly`). Placeholders are hints, never labels.

field-raised-placeholder.$description: Alias. `field-placeholder` in a field on a raised layer: in dark a step lighter, as zinc-400 is 4.07:1 on the zinc-700 `field-raised`.

backdrop.$description: Alias. The dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers (zinc-900 at 50% in light themes, zinc-950 at 70% in dark).

border-picture.$description: Alias. A hairline just inside a photo's edge (Image, Avatar), so a picture with a white or black background keeps its shape on a page of the same color: black at 10% in light themes, white at 10% in dark.

surface-inverse.$description: Alias. Contrasting blocks: tooltips, inverse banners.

text.$description: Alias. Body text and headings on `surface`.

text-muted.$description: Alias. Secondary text, captions, placeholders (4.5:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

text-secondary.$description: Alias. Secondary text inside a shaded row (`surface-hover`, `surface-raised-hover`: hovered, selected or striped), where `text-muted` would fall under 4.5:1 on zinc-100: zinc-600 in light, `text-muted`'s zinc-400 in dark. 4.5:1+ on either fill in every theme.

border.$description: Alias. Default borders and dividers: zinc-200 in light; zinc-800 in dark, a step off the zinc-900 cards and bars it outlines. A quiet line, never a control's boundary: those use `field-border` or `border-strong`.

border-strong.$description: Alias. Emphasized dividers and outlines. Form fields use `field-border` (softer by design; `border-strong` meets 3:1).

track.$description: Alias. The empty part of a track: Switch off, Slider, Meter and Progress, at the level Apple's controls use (zinc-200 in light, zinc-700 in dark). The thumb, fill or edge on it carries the 3:1.

track-hover.$description: Alias. The empty part of a track under the pointer, a step darker than `track` (Switch off: zinc-300 in light, zinc-600 in dark). A fill, not an edge.

track-pressed.$description: Alias. The empty part of a track while held down, a step past `track-hover` (Switch off: zinc-500 in light, zinc-400 in dark). A fill, not an edge.

border-raised.$description: Alias. The edge of a top-layer surface (Menu, Popover, Dialog, Drawer, Toast, the picker lists), and the lines inside it. In dark it is one step stronger than `border`, so a menu stands off the page.

focus-ring.$description: Alias. Keyboard focus outline, in the brand hue (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme). More contrast: brand 700 / brand 300.

surface-success.$description: Alias. Success icons and fills (3:1): green-600 in light, a touch lighter in dark (#23a950), as every dark fill is (ADR-0026). For success text use `text-success`.

text-success.$description: Alias. Success text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-success-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-success-hover.$description: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `surface-success` fills; `text-on-success` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

text-on-success.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `surface-success` fills (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-success-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. Hover fill of an interactive `surface-success-subtle` surface; `text-success` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

border-success.$description: Alias. Border of a success outline control or callout.

surface-warning.$description: Alias. Warning icons and fills: amber-600 in light, a touch lighter in dark (#e07d17); put dark text on it. For warning text use `text-warning`.

text-warning.$description: Alias. Warning text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-warning-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-warning-hover.$description: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `surface-warning` fills; `text-on-warning` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

text-on-warning.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `surface-warning` fills (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-warning-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. Hover fill of an interactive `surface-warning-subtle` surface; `text-warning` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

border-warning.$description: Alias. Border of a warning outline control or callout.

surface-danger.$description: Alias. Errors, destructive buttons; white text on it (4.5:1+): red-600 in light, a touch lighter in dark (#e22e2c). For error text use `text-danger`.

surface-danger-pressed.$description: Alias. Pressed state of `surface-danger`: one step past `surface-danger-hover`; `text-on-danger` keeps 4.5:1 on it.

text-on-danger.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `surface-danger` fills.

text-danger.$description: Alias. Destructive text and icons on `surface`, `surface-danger-subtle` and its hover (5.3:1+ in every theme).

surface-danger-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. Hover fill for destructive secondary, outline and ghost buttons.

border-danger.$description: Alias. Border of a destructive outline button.

surface-info.$description: Alias. Informational icons and fills (3:1), with white `text-on-info` text: sky-700 in light, the same shade lightened only as far as 3:1 on a raised dark card in dark (#1e77b0). For info text use `text-info`.

text-info.$description: Alias. Info text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-info-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-info-hover.$description: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `surface-info` fills; `text-on-info` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

text-on-info.$description: Alias. Text and icons on `surface-info` fills (4.5:1+ in every theme).

surface-info-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. Hover fill of an interactive `surface-info-subtle` surface; `text-info` stays 4.5:1+ on it.

border-info.$description: Alias. Border of a info outline control or callout.

text-link-visited.$description: Alias. A visited link in reading content (Prose): a shade apart from primary, 4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-sunken` in every theme.

chart-1.$description: Alias. Chart series 1 (blue): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-2.$description: Alias. Chart series 2 (orange): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-3.$description: Alias. Chart series 3 (pink): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-4.$description: Alias. Chart series 4 (cyan): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-5.$description: Alias. Chart series 5 (brown): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-6.$description: Alias. Chart series 6 (teal): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-7.$description: Alias. Chart series 7 (violet): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-8.$description: Alias. Chart series 8 (red): a line, bar, slice or marker. Every series is 3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme; neighbors differ by hue for every reader (OKLab ΔE 15+, 8+ under protanopia and deuteranopia), the first four as every pair (15+, 10+ under protanopia and deuteranopia, 8+ under tritanopia), alternate darker and lighter in light themes, and `chart-gap` keeps them apart.

chart-seq-1.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 1 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-2.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 2 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-3.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 3 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-4.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 4 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before.

chart-seq-5.$description: Alias. Sequential ramp, step 5 of 5 (low to high): a heat map or a choropleth. Each step stands out more from `surface` than the one before, and the last is 3:1+.

chart-div-1.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 1 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle; the ends are 3:1+.

chart-div-2.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 2 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-3.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 3 of 7 (below the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-4.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 4 of 7 (the middle, no change): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-5.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 5 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-6.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 6 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle.

chart-div-7.$description: Alias. Diverging ramp, step 7 of 7 (above the middle): change from a baseline, red under it and blue over it. Steps stand out more from `surface` the further they are from the middle; the ends are 3:1+.

chart-grid.$description: Alias. Chart grid lines: quiet, behind the data.

chart-axis.$description: Alias. Chart axis lines and ticks (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

chart-label.$description: Alias. Chart axis labels, values and legend text (4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme).

chart-gap.$description: Alias. The gap drawn between neighboring bars, slices and areas, so each one has 3:1+ against what touches it (WCAG 1.4.11). The page color: set it to the card's on a raised surface.
